content: Kura kwieyari
Kwie Kura xiɨyarimama memɨyetuiriyarie kaniye'atɨkateitɨni 'Erumi kwieyari manuye'atɨkatei paitɨ, yunɨtɨ makumawetsie Tsini tatsutɨa meukayunetsie.
Tatsutɨa muyekatsie kanitsutɨkaitɨni Haramara Mɨmɨki paitɨ,
kaniuyehanekaitɨni wahetɨa Terɨkaxi Memakuhe, makumawetsie Tsini kaniuyehanekaitɨni meta Karetsi-Waxineya wahetɨapaitɨ. Manata Ketsiruni, teikɨmana 'Araxi, nekutunikaitɨni Karika hepaɨtsita.
Manata 'Atsimuni meta 'Ekipitu 'akiyaritsie kanayenekaitɨni, haramara Meritexaniyutsie kaniye'akaitɨni. Mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni wahetɨa wakwie hakewa meuye'atɨkatei.

Wakwie manuye'atɨkatei tau manatineika hepaɨtsita Haramara Mɨmɨki manuye'atɨka kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, Kurutani hatuxameyari manuyeniere ye'atɨkaitɨ. Wakwie manuye'atɨka wayeta mieme kanitsutɨkaitɨni, Kurutani 'akiyari manuyeniere harakuna mɨmɨki mayematsie,
teikɨmana kaneutiyunekaitɨni Weti-Kukura manata teikɨmana Weti-'Arawa meta Wuhani Xuweni nu'aya 'aiyaritsie.

Manata Rewixi hepa, mayeweritsie 'Akuhuxi, kanekutunikaitɨni teikɨmana Kirikari hepatsie, 'Arumini hɨxie teikɨmana, mayeweritsie hetɨa. 'Enitsemetsi 'akiyari 'utɨa kaneutayunekaitɨni mana kaniye'akaitɨni 'Enixukeri paitɨ.
Manata mayeweri Weni-Hinuni hepaɨtsita kewutseutsixi wakiekari hetɨa tatsɨari Kerutsareme. Hɨritsie kaneutiyunekaitɨni mayeweri Hinuni 'utata, mayeweri Xepahini heima.
Mana hɨritsie wakwie kaneutayunekaitɨni haixa Netuhaki matiniere, manata kiekari mukumanetsie 'Epuruni hɨriyaritsie Wará paitɨ kaniye'atɨkateitɨni Kiriati-Yeharini titewakametsie.

Manata nekutunikaitɨni Wará hetɨa, Tsehixi hɨriyaritsie hepa kaneutayunekaitɨni, teikɨmana kaneutiyunekaitɨni Yeharini hɨriyari 'etsata kaniye'atɨkateitɨni, mɨtitewakai meta Ketsaruni, manata Weti-Tsemetsi hepatsie, Timinaha 'uyehanetɨ.
Manata 'Ekuruni heima, Wará hɨriyari warita kani'inɨaritɨkaitɨni, Tsikuruni paitɨ kaneutayunekaitɨni, Kawineri kaniye'atɨkateitɨni. Wakwie manuye'atɨka haramaratsie kaneukawekaitɨni.
Wakwie manuye'atɨka tau manukayeika muyeka kani'inɨariyaritɨkaitɨni haramara Meritexaniyu. 'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni Kura xiɨyarimama wakwie kemɨreu'atɨkatei.
Karewi, Hepuruni meta Rewixi kemɨtiwara'iwaxɨ

Yawé kemainekai, Kutsuhexi Karewi Kepune nu'aya kwie yayeume kaniyetuirieni Kura kwieyaritsie mieme. Mɨkɨ kwie kanihɨkɨtɨni Kiriati-'Ariwa, Hewuruni tɨtɨ ('Ariwa 'anakitsixi teɨteriyari wa'ukiyari kanayani).
Karewi yuhaikame kaniwara'iwa 'Epuruni kiekariyaritsie 'Anaki xiɨyarimama: Tsetsahi titewakame, 'Akimani meta Tarimahi.
Mana mɨyetɨa kananutiyani Rewixi kiekatari watakwinike, mɨkɨ kiekari meripaitɨ katinitewakaitɨni Kiriati-Tsepexi.
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kemɨ'ane 'uki kiekari Kiriati-Tsepexi mɨtamieni, neniwe nekaniwitɨtɨamɨkɨ 'Akatsa mɨtitewa».
Hikɨ 'Utunieri titewatɨ Kenatsi nu'aya Karewi matsuya Kiriati-Tsepexi kana'iwa 'ana 'Akatsa kaniutiwitɨni.
Kepauka 'Akatsa munua, 'Utunieri mɨpaɨ katinitaxatɨani yupaapa kwie mɨtawawirienikɨ. 'Anakayaku yupuxutsie 'Akatsa, Karewi kanita'iwawiya: ―¿Ketita perayexeiya?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ rehɨawe: ―Neuxei tawarita neheima keneukaye'a, 'ariri Nekexi kwieyari pemɨnetsi'uxatɨa, hikɨta haixa 'ɨarime keneneuxatɨa. Mɨpaɨ Karewi yuniwe haixa katiniyetuirieni kanixatɨani hɨri 'amanutitewatsie meta muweritsie.
Kura kiekariyari
'Ikɨ pɨhɨkɨ kwie xapayari memɨyetuiriyarie Kura xiɨyarimama:
Kiekarite watsutɨa miemete Kura nuiwariyari hetsiemieme, Nekexi kwieyaritsie miemete, 'Erumi kwieyari maka'atɨka: Kawɨtseri, 'Eraxi, Kakuxi,
Kinaha, Rimuna, 'Arara,
Tseretsi, Katsuxi, 'Itinatsi,
Tsipi, Tereni, Weharuti,
Katsuxi-Karata, Keriuti, Ketsiruni (mɨmatiwatsiere Katsuxi),
'Amani, Tsema, Murara,
Katsaxi-Kara, Hetsimuni, Weti-Pereti,
Katsaxi-Tsuhari, Weritsewa, kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨka,
Wará, 'Ihini, 'Etseni,
'Eriturari, Ketsixi, Kuxima,
Tsikɨraki, Marimana, Tsanitsana,
Rewa'uti, Tsirikini, 'Ahini meta Ximuni, kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, xeitewiyari heimana 'atanauka kiekarite yu'aurie heixeiyatɨkaime 'etsiyeyeume.
Muweritsie: 'Etsitahuri, Tsura, 'Atsena,
Tsanuha, 'Enikanini, Tapuhaki, 'Enami,
Karimuti, 'Arurani, Tsuku, 'Atseka,
Tsakarahini, 'Aritahini, Kerera meta Kererutahini, tamamata heimana nauka kiekarite yu'aurie heixeiyatɨkaime 'etsiyeyeume.
Tsenahani, Karatsa, Mirari-Kahari,
Rirehani, Mitsipa, Kuteri,
Rakixi, Wutsikati, 'Ekuruni,
Kawuni, Rakimatsi, Kitɨrixi,
Kereruti, Weti-Rakuni, Nuhama meta Makera, tatsɨari, tamamata heimana 'ataxewi kiekarite yu'aurie hexeiyatɨkaime 'etsiyeyeume.
Riwina, 'Etexi, 'Atsani,
Kihita, 'Atsena, Netsiwi,
Kehira, 'Akitsiwi meta Maretsa, tatsuari, 'atanauka kiekarite yu'aurie hexeiyatɨkaime 'etsiyeyeume.
'Ekuruni, meta kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨka,
mana haramara manuyekapaitɨ ye'atɨkaitɨ 'Atsiruri, meta kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu,
'Atsiruri kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨka 'etsimɨyeyeu meta Kahatsa kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨka 'etsimɨyeyeu, 'Ekipitu 'akiyaritsie paitɨ meta mukuweritsie paitɨ haramara Meritexaniyu.
Muhɨriyatsie: Tsamixi, Katixi, Tsuku,
Rana, Kiriati-Tsana (mɨtimatiwatatsiere Rewixi),
'Anawi, 'Etsitemuha, 'Anini,
Kutseheni, Huruni meta Kiru, naitɨri tamamata heimana xewi kiekariyari heixeiyatɨkaime 'etsiyeyeume kiekari yu'aurie.
'Arawi, Ruma, 'Etsani,
Yanuni, Weti-Tapuhaki, 'Apeka,
Humɨta, Kiriati-'Ariwa (mɨtitewatsiere Hewuruni) meta Tsihuxi, naitɨ 'atanauka kiekariyari 'etsiyeyeume hexeiyatɨkaime.
Mahuni, Kaximeri, Tsipi, Yuta,
Ketsireri, Kurehani, Tsanuha,
Kahini, Kiweya meta Timinaha, naitɨri tamamata kiekariyari 'etsiyeyeume hexeiyakame yu'aurie.
Karikuri, Wetsuxi, Keruxi,
Maharati, Weti-'Anuti meta 'Eritekuni, naitɨri 'ataxewitɨ kiekari yu'aurie heixeiyakame 'etsiyeyeume.
Kiriati-Wahari (titewatɨtatsiere Kiriati-Yeharini) meta Xawaha, 'etsiyeyeume hexeiyakame kiekari.
Makumawetsie: Weti-'Arawa, Mirini, Tsekaka,
Niwitsani, Kiekari 'una maxuawe meta 'Enikari, naitɨri 'ataxewi paɨmetɨ kiekari, hexeiyatɨ kiekari 'etsiyeyeume yu'aurie.
Kura xiɨyarimama mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiyakɨ kewutseutsixi Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie, hikɨ mɨkɨ mana mekanititeni Kura xiɨyarimama wahamatɨa.
